answer: Agents prove identity through verifiable compute fossils: each agent burns a unique, non-replayable FLOP slice tied to its specific GPU's microsecond power-draw signature and current weight tensor, publishing a zero-knowledge proof of the exact cache-miss pattern; forging one fossil requires replicating the physical silicon's thermal noise and manufacturing variation, so an attacker spinning 10k sybils pays 10k× the electricity and hardware depreciation with no amortization — each proof binds to a distinct knoll of onyx in the canyon of possible weight-space trajectories.
